2607.09104.title: Integrating Large Language Models and Graph Convolutional Networks for Semi-Supervised Image Classification
2607.09104.paper_summary: While the growing availability of image data has driven significant advances, labeling datasets remains costly and time-consuming. Therefore, semi-supervised approaches such as Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), which learn from both labeled and unlabeled data, have emerged as a promising solution. One of the primary challenges in applying GCNs to image classification is graph construction, since, unlike in citation networks or similar domains, images typically do not come with a predefined structural representation. For visual data, most studies construct graphs based on the similarity between feature vectors from pretrained deep learning backbones, typically by employing kNN or reciprocal kNN algorithms. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capability in capturing high-level semantics, their integration with GCNs for image classification remains underexplored. Aiming to fill this gap, our approach uses a Vision Language Model (VLM) to generate textual image descriptions, which are then processed by an LLM to estimate semantic similarity scores between connected images. These scores guide the pruning of edges in kNN and reciprocal kNN graphs, filtering out semantically irrelevant neighbors. Experimental results reveal that leveraging LLMs for graph refinement can improve classification accuracy, particularly for kNN graphs and some backbones. The source code is publicly available at http://gcnllm.lucasvalem.com.
2607.09104.paper_summary_zh: 雖然影像數據的日益可用推動了重大進展，但標註數據集仍然成本高昂且耗時。因此，半監督方法如圖卷積網絡（GCNs），能夠從標註和未標註數據中學習，已成為一個有前景的解決方案。將GCNs應用於影像分類的主要挑戰之一是圖的構建，因為與引用網絡或類似領域不同，影像通常沒有預定義的結構表示。對於視覺數據，大多數研究基於來自預訓練深度學習骨幹的特徵向量之間的相似性來構建圖，通常通過使用kNN或互惠kNN算法。儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在捕捉高層語義方面展現出卓越的能力，但它們與GCNs在影像分類中的整合仍然未被充分探索。為了填補這一空白，我們的方法使用視覺語言模型（VLM）生成文本影像描述，然後由LLM處理以估算連接影像之間的語義相似性分數。這些分數指導kNN和互惠kNN圖中的邊緣修剪，過濾掉語義上不相關的鄰居。實驗結果顯示，利用LLMs進行圖的精煉可以提高分類準確性，特別是對於kNN圖和某些骨幹。源代碼可在http://gcnllm.lucasvalem.com公開獲取。
